title: AutoContext instructions catalog
description: Hand-authored curatorial taxonomy: the presentation categories, the per-file catalog entries, and the always-attached file set. Cross-validated against the instruction corpus at build time by the manifest generator.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema file. Enables editor IntelliSense.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog format version. Bumped on breaking changes.

alwaysAttached.description: Corpus files the engine injects into every turn unconditionally. Declared here as the single source of truth for the always-attached set; deliberately omitted from 'instructions' and must not also appear there.

categories.description: Presentation categories, in display order. Each entry's category membership must resolve to one of these names.

instructions.description: Curated per-file entries. Every non-always-attached corpus file must have exactly one entry here.

instructionFileName.description: A corpus instruction file name (kebab-case, '.instructions.md' suffix).

name.description: Category name entries reference by value. Unique across the catalog.

fileName.description: The corpus file this entry decorates (the join key into the generated manifest). Unique across the catalog.

category.description: Category name this entry belongs to. Must resolve to a declared category.

activationFlags.description: Workspace-state flags (camelCase) that gate when the engine surfaces this entry. Omit when the entry is always offered.
